column1: # survey: 2026 Iowa Farm Custom Rate Survey (Ag Decision Maker File A3-10, FM 1698, revised March 2026)
# publisher: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach
# collected: survey sent to 1,122 people in early February 2026; 205 responses, 4,698 rates; rates expected to be charged or paid in 2026

# includes: All rates include fuel, repairs, depreciation, interest, operator labor, and all other machinery costs for the tractor and implement, unless otherwise noted. Diesel assumed at $2.89 a gallon (February 2026).
# range_note: The range leaves out the single lowest and highest answer, as the survey reports it.
